api.title: API & website export

api.ep2: One listing: all parameters, photos, price history

exp.apiSub: Push listings to any client website
exp.apiS: REST API and XML feed for your website: filtered listing queries, a full feed refreshed every 15 minutes, webhooks for new listings, price and status changes. Portals: Sahibinden does not accept listings from external systems (manual posting only; its API, mandated by the Competition Board, exports listings out, not in); Hepsiemlak and Emlakjet connect exports for partner programs under an agreement — the feed is ready, we switch it on once the agreement is signed.
exp.soonS: Under agreement with the portal — in progress

exp.noImpS: Manual posting on the portal only
exp.noImpT: Sahibinden does not accept listings from external systems — post there manually
exp.s: The listing is published on the selected portals under your name and stays in sync.
exp.note: Demo: portal connections are configured by the database admin.
